responsibility: Top-level GNU make fragment that integrates the GNU Modula-2 front end into GCC’s normal build, install, documentation, and testsuite machinery. It defines the gm2 and cc1gm2 programs as language targets, builds the gm2 driver from gm2spec.o plus common GCC driver objects, includes generated configuration from m2/config-make, and owns the bootstrap and archive-building rules for GM2 compiler modules, runtime libraries, parser generator tools, plugins, manuals, and check-gm2 hooks, making it the central build orchestration file for the whole gcc/m2 submodule.
